per_object_cap.stated: The file size limit for a PDF is 700 MB.

egress.terms: free, CDN-served download links on substackcdn.com, no auth for public posts

record.tooling: No public upload API. File embeds are drag-and-drop in the post editor or into email drafts; would need browser automation (Playwright) against the logged-in editor.
record.chaining: 700 MB x unlimited posts x unlimited publications (each free to create). This is the largest per-file limit of any social platform checked here; 20 TiB = ~29,000 PDFs
record.limits_note: 700 MB/PDF; only PDF, XLSX, CBZ, CBR accepted as embeddable files; paywall/email delivery adds processing; publication needs a verified email and payment setup for paid tiers
record.reliability_note: Attachments live with the post; editing a post can drop the embed; Substack has no delete-then-restore story. No API is the hard blocker. This is a 'if someone writes the Playwright wrapper' candidate.
record.confidence_note: the Substack support article states that the file size limit for a PDF is 700 MB
